description: Sometime after the Gates appeared in this world, people were divided into two categories— \[Users\] and the \[Regulars\]. The Users are able to choose a \[Class\] as they awaken... But due to a momentary lapse of judgement, Choi Yikyung ended up choosing the worst of all classes, 'Necromancer'. Meanwhile, Yikyung finally manages to convince his Servant \[Lackey\] to pair up with him to go to the \[Tower of Spirits\] and comes face to face with the truth about the cause of the incident! “I will do anything really... Please sign a contract with me and help me!” —You will do anything...? \[Would you like to accept the ‘oath’ offered by ‘Seo Dawon’?\] ―You will do your best to help me with my revenge. And I will do my best to save you whenever and wherever you are in danger. What do you say? \[The contract with the new Servant ‘Seo Dawon’ has begun.\] A thrilling contract revenge drama between Low-ranked 'Necromancer' Choi Yikyung and Ranker 'Mage' Seo Dawon! \[Original Promo/Novel\](https://ridibooks.com/books/3822000323)
